backstory:
# Situation

Santa Catalina sits astride the approaches to Los Angeles and the busy coastwise lanes that feed Southern California ports. In peacetime the water is crowded and predictable. In a crisis it becomes a choke where commercial traffic, naval presence, and political signaling collide inside a few dozen nautical miles.

Pacific Fleet order **44-7** assigns USS Los Angeles (SSN-688) to a covert barrier patrol south of the island: hold station, stay quiet, and be ready if the situation hardens.

## Background

Tensions across the Pacific have climbed through a sequence of incidents short of open war — contested EEZ claims, aggressive shadowing of merchant shipping, and competing naval deployments framed as "exercises." Neither side wants a shooting war off a major U.S. metro area; both want the other to blink first.

Catalina is useful precisely because it is close to home. A hostile presence here threatens coastal shipping and raises the political cost of inaction. An American response here risks escalation in view of civilian traffic and allied units sharing the same water.

## Flashpoints

- **Sea lines of communication** — tankers and merchants still run the Catalina corridor; any disruption is felt ashore within days
- **Covert access** — diesel boats can linger on battery near shipping noise and deny clear attribution until it is too late
- **ASW pressure** — surface and air ASW can "sanitize" the approaches, or provoke a misread if they press too hard on the wrong contact
- **Blue-on-blue risk** — friendly combatants and a sister SSN may share the belt; **positive ID before weapons**
- **Political optics** — a public clash in Southern California waters forces Washington and the adversary into irreversible choices

## Intent

Your barrier is meant to keep options open: detect and report, hold fire until tasked, and preserve acoustic discretion while the crisis is still reversible. If the order comes to engage, identification under dense civilian traffic is the hard problem — not finding water to shoot in.

missions.comm_briefing:
# FLASH — On station

**FROM:** COMSUBPAC  
**TO:** USS LOS ANGELES (SSN-688)

## Immediate

- Proceed to assigned OP AREA vicinity Santa Catalina Island
- Conduct covert patrol — remain undetected
- Do **not** engage until directed
- Come to communications depth and raise HF antenna for follow-on tasking
missions.debrief_lead:
# After action

COMSUBPAC acknowledges your report. Hostile diesel submarine is confirmed sunk. The Catalina barrier holds; Los Angeles remains on station.

debrief_lines.on_fail:
## Surface combatant

Hostile surface combatant was not both identified and sunk. The corvette remains a threat to merchant traffic along the Catalina lanes.
debrief_lines.on_success:
## Surface combatant

Hostile surface combatant was positively identified and sunk. Inshore ASW sweeps in your area have ceased.

debrief_lines.on_fail:
## Tanker search

Tanker search incomplete — no positive identification. A large merchant contact may still be in the transit lanes.
debrief_lines.on_success:
## Tanker search

MT Horizon was located and positively identified. She was not engaged, in accordance with ROE.

missions.description:
# Mission

Establish covert patrol in assigned OP AREA south of Santa Catalina Island.

## Intel

- Diesel submarine activity along merchant transit lanes
- Inshore ASW surface units (Grisha-class expected)
- Dense neutral shipping — merchants, tanker, trawler

## Notes

Allied forces hold the eastern patrol belt. Remain undetected until follow-on tasking via COMM.

actions.text:
# IMMEDIATE — Execute

**FROM:** COMSUBPAC  
**TO:** USS LOS ANGELES (SSN-688)

## Primary

- Locate and **sink** hostile diesel submarine in your OP AREA

## Secondary

- Locate, positively identify, and **sink** hostile surface combatant
- Locate and positively identify tanker — **do not engage**

## ID criteria

- Visual via periscope inside **3000 yards**, or
- Acoustic fingerprint — **80%** harmonic match with library etalon held two minutes

## Restrictions

- Civilian shipping is **not** to be engaged
- Report completion via this channel

# IMMEDIATE — Tanker cue

**FROM:** COMSUBPAC  
**TO:** USS LOS ANGELES (SSN-688)

## Foxtrot

- Hostile diesel kill **confirmed**

## Tanker track (do not engage)

- Contact **{{unit.civ_tanker.name}}** estimated at **{{unit.civ_tanker.pos}}**
- Course approx **{{unit.civ_tanker.course}}** true, speed ~**{{unit.civ_tanker.speed}}** kts
- Positively **identify** for secondary; weapons hold on merchants

objectives.description: Locate and sink hostile diesel submarine
Identify and sink hostile surface combatant
Locate and identify tanker (do not engage)

missions.title: Santa Catalina Approaches

missions.comm_briefing:
# FLASH — Barrier hold

**FROM:** COMSUBPAC  
**TO:** USS LOS ANGELES (SSN-688)

## Status

- Remain on Catalina barrier
- Foxtrot kill **confirmed**
- Expect hostile reaction force
- Raise COMM for follow-on tasking
missions.debrief_lead:
# After action

COMSUBPAC acknowledges your report. The Catalina barrier held against the hostile counterstroke.

missions.description:
# Mission

Hostile reaction after the Foxtrot kill.

## Threats

- Quieter **Kilo** probes the barrier from NW
- **Udaloy** closes from the east to pincer Los Angeles
- Surviving **Grisha** (if not sunk in mission 1) returns as a hardened threat

## Shipping picture

Dense merchant traffic remains on the Catalina lanes. Prior tanker tasking from mission 1 still matters — expect further COMM on contacts of interest once you are on station.

## Friendly

- Spruance remains eastern support (assists on hostile surface fire)
- Bremerton has been redirected

**TO:** USS LOS ANGELES (SSN-688)

## Primary

- Locate and **sink** hostile Kilo-class diesel entering from NW
- Locate, positively identify, and **sink** hostile Udaloy DDG approaching from east

## Tanker (revised ROE)

- **Sink** tanker MT Horizon — now assessed hostile support
- Approx position **{{unit.civ_tanker.pos}}**, course **{{unit.civ_tanker.course}}** true

## ID criteria

- Visual via periscope inside **3000 yards**, or
- Acoustic fingerprint — **80%** harmonic match held two minutes

## Support

- USS Spruance holds eastern edge; will support on **hostile surface fire**

postscript_failure:
# Campaign failed

COMSUBPAC notes mission failure. The Catalina barrier is compromised. A relief SSN is being routed to your datum.
postscript_success:
# Campaign complete

COMSUBPAC acknowledges your report. Hostile units neutralized. Los Angeles is released from the Catalina barrier.
